story.festival_colours.name: Festival of colours
story.festival_colours.desc: A festival-of-colours challenge: dye ten things.
story.festival_colours.ch.c1.sum: Colour everywhere. Dye ten building materials.
story.festival_colours.r1.start: A festival of colours is on! Today everything may be bright pink, yellow and green. Dye ten things at the workbench and I have something colourful for you.
story.festival_colours.graduated: Splendid colours. Rugs and flower pots to paint in every shade.
story.festival_colours.d1.start: Dye ten building materials — any block, any colour.
story.festival_colours.d1.done: Ten colours! Your base has never looked this bright.
